title: Spiral Matrix II
statement: Build an n by n matrix holding 1 to n*n placed in spiral order: left to right along the top, down the right side, right to left along the bottom, up the left side, then inward. This is Spiral Matrix run backwards - you are writing the cells rather than reading them.
hints: The traversal is identical to reading a spiral. Only the body of the loop changes: assign a counter instead of appending to a list.
Four boundaries again - top, bottom, left, right - each shrinking after the edge it owns has been walked.

Because the matrix is square you never hit the non-square degenerate case, but an odd n still ends on a single centre cell. Stop on the count reaching n*n rather than trying to detect that separately.

cases.name: n=3: odd, ends on the centre
n=4: two full laps, no centre
n=5: two laps then a lone centre
